<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'> ">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special chars: <>&"' -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some CDATA content with <tags> and &entities; inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Standard Item">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Deluxe">
  <!ENTITY % remote_macro SYSTEM "http://example.com/notfound.dtd">
  %remote_macro;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="afl" data="test-mode=true"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/schema" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line comment 
       with DTD entities and CDATA interaction -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      <item-details>
        Description goes here: &extended;
      </item-details>
    ]]>
  </item>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly">
  <!ENTITY reference "Book ID: 12345">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY sample SYSTEM "sample.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:bk="http://catalog.org/ns/book">
  <!-- Comment before complex elements -->
  <bk:book id="b1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with embedded XML-like markup: <book>&reference;</book>
    ]]>
  </bk:book>
  <book>&pub; - &reference;</book>
</catalog>
```
